label: Causes of being of actual concreta exist at w, from the giver of being
description: New non-transcription derivation of the analyst leaf STMT-ESSE-CAUSES-EXIST-AT. Let x be an actual concretum at w and c cause x's being. x exists at w, so it is in act as to being (existence-to-act contract); nothing gives being that it does not have, so c is in act as to being; whatever is in act as to being exists at w (the open act-to-existence converse, which reads the timeless InAct relative to the selected world), so c exists at w. Each premise is needed in a checked interpretation (controls 3, 4 and 5). The open content of the old leaf divides into the classical maxim at being and the actualist reading of esse at the reading world. No premise is established.
